function uttFitness(utt, obj_idx)

# literal listener: uniform over context POSITIONS (so duplicate objects in a context
# correctly get extra weight), soft-factored by utterance fitness
@gen function L0_model(utt_idx::Int, context::Vector{Int})
    pos = ({:pos} ~ uniform_discrete(1, length(context)))
    oidx = context[pos]
    {:pot} ~ __pplgym_factor(uttFitness(possibleUtterances[utt_idx], oidx))
    return oidx
end

function L0dist(utt_idx, context)
    tr, lw, _ = enumerative_inference(L0_model, (utt_idx, context), choicemap((:pot,0.0)),
        choice_vol_grid((:pos, collect(1:length(context)))))
    w = exp.(lw)
    d = Dict{Int,Float64}()
    for (t,wi) in zip(tr,w)
        oidx = get_retval(t)
        d[oidx] = get(d, oidx, 0.0) + wi
    end
    s = sum(values(d))
    if s > 0
        for k in keys(d); d[k] /= s; end
    end
    return d
end

# speaker's marginal literal-listener probability of `target`, having uncertainty over the
# occluded object (uniformly over all 9 possibleObjects appended to the shared context)
function listener_marginal_prob(utt_idx, sharedContext, target_idx)
    total = 0.0
    for hidden in 1:n_obj
        ctx = vcat(sharedContext, [hidden])
        d = L0dist(utt_idx, ctx)
        total += get(d, target_idx, 0.0)
    end
    return total / n_obj
end
